literal: Battle possessing even to those of strength, fortress having reached becoming advantage many will give.
translation: Even to those possessing formidable strength in battle, reaching a fortress will yield many advantages.
modern: போரில் வெற்றிபெறும் வலிமை உடையவர்களுக்கும், ஒரு அரணை அடைந்து செயல்படுவது பல நன்மைகளைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the strategic importance of a secure location, specifically a fortress, regardless of one's inherent power. The phrase 'முரண் சேர்ந்த மொய்ம்பினவர்க்கும்' refers to warriors who already possess immense, battle-hardened strength. One might assume such powerful fighters do not need defensive structures. However, the couplet explains that the advantage gained by operating from a stronghold ('அரண் சேர்ந்தாம் ஆக்கம்') is substantial, as it multiplies their natural strength and yields many successes.
